notes: Total 60 as published; section headers are not cards. Starting (6) as posted: Hunt Down, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Executor: Holotheatre, Visage Of The Emperor, Twi'lek Advisor and Imperial Arrest Order (5 Visage and 4 Twi'lek Advisor in all). Several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty; Twi'lek Advisor is an ordinary Interrupt.

Posted 'Cloud City Docking Bay' dested the Dark Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay) (Platform 327 is the Light site); 'Death Star Docking Bay' Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'Endor Docking Bay' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay).

Posted 'DLOTS' dested Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Vader w/ Saber' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Boba w/ Blaster' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; '4-Lom w/ Rifle' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Grsnd Moff Tarkin' Grand Moff Tarkin; 'Reactot Terminal' Reactor Terminal; Sniper and Alter are the Premiere/Endor Interrupts (pre-combo). Come Here You Big Coward is the older Effect.
Title clash: the author's later post 10292 (8 September 2000, a different list) is live as [[Chris Aven Aven s DOcking Bay Hunt Down]], so this June 2000 post gets a dated dest_title.
